Screen.summary: UI root node that manages screen size, hovered/focused/active control state and input event dispatch.

props.classname: Root node class name, fixed to 'screen'.
props.x: Root node x coordinate, fixed to 0 (the root has no parent offset).
props.y: Root node y coordinate, fixed to 0.
props.width: Screen/canvas width in pixels; New uses the Spring.GetViewSizes width when unset or <=0.
props.height: Screen/canvas height in pixels; New uses the view height rounded up when unset or <=0.
props.preserveChildrenOrder: Whether the children order is preserved, default true.
props.activeControl: Control that currently holds the mouse button (weak reference); later MouseMove/MouseUp/MouseWheel events go to it first.
props.focusedControl: Control with the keyboard focus (weak reference); KeyPress/TextInput are forwarded to it first.
props.hoveredControl: Control currently under the mouse (weak reference).
props.currentTooltip: Tooltip text to display, taken from the hovered control or the first ancestor that has a tooltip.
props._lastHoveredControl: Control hovered on the previous frame, used to detect hover changes and send MouseOver/MouseOut (internal).
props._lastClicked: Timestamp of the last click (Spring.GetTimer()), used for double-click detection.
props._lastClickedX: Screen x of the last click, used for double-click detection.
props._lastClickedY: Screen y of the last click, used for double-click detection.

Screen:New.desc: Constructs the root node: fills in the size from Spring.GetViewSizes when unset or <=0, registers the global dispose callback and calls RequestUpdate.

Screen:OnGlobalDispose.desc: Clears the active/focused/hovered/_lastHovered references that point at a control being globally disposed.

Screen:ParentToLocal.desc: The root has no parent transform, so x,y are returned unchanged.

Screen:LocalToParent.desc: The root is its own parent, so x,y are returned unchanged.

Screen:LocalToScreen.desc: The root frame is the screen frame, so x,y are returned unchanged.

Screen:ScreenToLocal.desc: Converts screen to local coordinates; returns them unchanged (the y flip is done by the caller).

Screen:ScreenToClient.desc: Converts screen to client coordinates; returns them unchanged.

Screen:UnscaledClientToScreen.desc: Multiplies unscaled client coordinates by WG.uiScale to get screen coordinates.

Screen:ClientToScreen.desc: Client coordinates are screen coordinates here, so x,y are returned unchanged.

Screen:IsRectInView.desc: Whether the rect intersects the screen extent [0,width] x [0,height].

Screen:IsVisibleOnScreen.desc: The root node is always visible, so this always returns true.

Screen:Resize.desc: Sets the screen width/height (rounded up) and calls RequestRealign on all children.

Screen:Update.desc: Per-frame driver: clears the tooltip and sends MouseOut when the mouse left the window, otherwise replays MouseMove to the hovered control.

Screen:IsAbove.desc: Returns the topmost control at that position and refreshes hoveredControl/currentTooltip, sending MouseOver/MouseOut when the hovered control changes.
Screen:IsAbove.returns: Whether a control is at that position

Screen:MouseDown.desc: After a hit, records activeControl; on focus change it switches state.focused and calls FocusUpdate.

Screen:MouseUp.desc: Treats a press within 0.45 s and 3 pixels as a double click, sends MouseDblClick or MouseClick, then MouseUp.

Screen:MouseMove.desc: Mouse move: forwards to activeControl first (dy negated) and releases it when the child returns false; otherwise dispatches through the parent class.

Screen:MouseWheel.desc: Mouse wheel: forwards to activeControl first and releases it when the child returns false; otherwise dispatches through the parent class.

Screen:KeyPress.desc: Key press: forwards to focusedControl when present, otherwise through the parent class.

Screen:TextInput.desc: Text input: forwards to focusedControl when present, otherwise through the parent class.

fileDesc: Defines Screen, the UI root node (an Object subclass): screen size and coordinate conversion, plus hovered/focused/active control state, tooltips and mouse/keyboard event dispatch.
